releaseNotes:
• Lean 27.5 MB ARM64 Phone Build + On-Demand Runtimes: Ships built-in with Python 3.12, Dash, and the native C++ PTY bridge; Node.js (30.5 MB) and C/C++ Clang/LLVM (71.2 MB) download on-demand with SHA-256 verification and live Bento download cards
• Daily Coding Challenges & Streaks: Added interactive Home Daily Challenges folder card (Two-Sum, Palindrome Check, FizzBuzz), automated on-device test evaluation, difficulty points, and updated streak pill UI
• Redesigned Bento Settings Hub: Dedicated expandable panels for AI & Models, Local Sandbox, Appearance, and Onboarding Flow
• Execution & 16 KB Hardening: Added /system/bin/linker64 execution for compiled C/C++ and on-demand runtimes with 16 KB ELF page-alignment verification
